children: shares climbed about 1% in early Friday trading as SpaceX outlined plans to add hundreds of thousands of Nvidia processors to its Colossus 2 computing facility.

Colossus 2 currently has 110,000 GB200 chips and 440,000 GB300 chips. Musk said another 220,000 GB300 processors could be operational next week, with a further 220,000 expected in November and another batch possible by late December.

If those additions proceed, the facility could add as many as 660,000 GB300 chips before year-end. The expansion underscores the scale of computing infrastructure being assembled for AI workloads across Musk's businesses.

SpaceX has also been developing a commercial model around its computing capacity. Its prospectus said an agreement with Anthropic covers access to about 325,000 Nvidia GPUs across Colossus and Colossus 2, with payments of $1.25 billion a month after the initial ramp period.

title: Nvidia Stock Rises as Elon Musk Reveals Huge New AI Chip Plans
